plaatsen.tekst: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
